name: account_billing
summary: Lets you group several customer invoices into one Billing document, so the customer pays a single consolidated amount on a billing day instead of settling each invoice separately. Billings are created under Invoicing > Customers or Vendors > Billing, or from selected invoices with the Create Billing action on the invoice list.

name: account_global_discount
summary: Applies global percentage discounts to customer invoices and vendor bills. Discounts are defined once under Settings > Parameters > Global Discounts, assigned to customers or suppliers, and then appear in the Invoice Global Discounts section of each invoice. The invoice then shows the total discount and the amount before discounts.

name: account_invoice_advance_compensation
summary: Tracks advance payments from customers and suppliers and applies them against regular invoices. An advance is created with an Advance product, paid as normal, and then a compensation wizard on the invoice offsets part of it against the invoice amount. It uses a dedicated advance journal and supports multiple currencies.

name: account_invoice_auto_send_by_email
summary: Sends posted customer invoices by email automatically once a day, for invoices whose transmit method is Email and that have not been sent yet. Sending runs as background queue jobs, so users do not have to send each invoice by hand. The result shows in the invoice chatter once the email goes out.

name: account_invoice_check_picking_date
summary: Warns the user when a vendor bill's accounting date falls in a different month from the receipt it is billed against. The warning appears as a popup when the bill is confirmed, so the date can be corrected before posting. It applies to purchase bills linked to stock receipts.

name: account_invoice_check_total
summary: Adds a Verification Total field to vendor bills, where the user types the total printed on the supplier's bill. When the bill is confirmed, Odoo compares its computed total with that figure and shows the difference, which catches data-entry errors. It is switched on with the Check Total on Vendor Bills setting in the vendor payments section of invoicing settings.

name: account_invoice_clearing
summary: Provides a wizard that offsets open customer invoices against open vendor bills of the same partner (or its child contacts) by posting an intermediate journal entry. Select invoices or bills in a list view and use the Invoice Clearing action, then choose the amounts to clear. It works on the residual amounts of unpaid items.

name: account_invoice_crm_tag
summary: Copies the tags set on a sales order onto the invoices created from it, and onto any credit note made from those invoices. The tags then show on invoices and in invoice analysis reports. Tags are set under Other info on the sales order.

name: account_invoice_currency_by_partner
summary: Lets you set a default customer currency and a default vendor currency on each contact. New customer invoices and vendor bills for that contact then open in that currency automatically, and fall back to the standard currency choice when none is set. The fields sit on the Sales & Purchase tab of the contact.

name: account_invoice_custom_rounding
summary: Lets each invoice use its own tax calculation rounding method, instead of only the company-wide setting. The method can be set on a contact and is copied to that customer's invoices, and it can be changed on the invoice's Other Information tab. If nothing is selected, the company's rounding method applies.

name: account_invoice_date_due
summary: Makes the due date of an invoice editable even after it has been posted, and even when a payment term is set. Changing it also updates the related receivable or payable lines. Only users in the Allow to change due date group can edit it.

name: account_invoice_default_code_column
summary: Adds a dedicated Default code column to the printed invoice report, so the product code still appears even if someone renames the line description. Product codes sit in their own column, which makes printed invoices easier to read. It only changes the invoice report and PDF.

name: account_invoice_discount_date
summary: Adds a discount date to customer invoices and vendor bills for early payment discounts, and copies it to the receivable or payable lines. You can filter invoices to find those whose early discount is about to expire, so payments or collections happen in time. Early payment dates from payment terms are kept when the discount date changes.

name: account_invoice_discount_display_amount
summary: Shows the total discount amount and the total before discount on invoices, both in the form and on the printed invoice. These totals update when a discount is applied to any invoice line. No setup is needed.

name: account_invoice_fiscal_position_update
summary: This module is obsolete and no longer maintained. When the fiscal position or partner on an invoice changes, it updates the taxes and accounts on lines that have a product, and warns the user about lines without one. Newer standard Odoo behavior should be preferred where it covers the need.

name: account_invoice_fixed_discount
summary: Adds a fixed-amount discount field to each invoice line, so a set currency amount can be taken off a line instead of a percentage. The discount is also printed on the invoice report. It is an invoice-level change for sales and purchase invoices.

name: account_invoice_line_sequence
summary: Adds a line number to each invoice line, starting at 1 and counting up as lines are added or reordered. Section and note lines are skipped, and the number prints on the invoice report so customers can refer to lines easily. It is a display and print change only.

name: account_invoice_merge
summary: Adds a Merge Partner Invoice action on the invoice list. Select several draft invoices for the same customer or vendor, with the same type, currency and receivable account, and merge them into one invoice. It is meant for combining draft invoices before they are posted.

name: account_invoice_payment_term_date_due
summary: On invoices with a payment term, the due date is normally hidden. This module shows the computed due date on the invoice so users can see when payment is expected. It is a display change only.

name: account_invoice_pricelist
summary: Adds a pricelist field to customer invoices, filled from the customer's pricelist, which is used when lines are added by hand. Pricelist rules also apply in a multi-currency setting. Invoices can be grouped by pricelist in the list view.

name: account_invoice_pricelist_sale
summary: Copies the pricelist from a sales order onto the invoice created from it, so the invoice keeps the same pricing as the order. It extends the invoice pricelist feature and needs no extra setup.

name: account_invoice_refund_line_selection
summary: On the credit note wizard for a posted invoice, you can choose the refund specific lines option and pick only the invoice lines to refund, instead of reversing the whole invoice. This is how partial credit notes are made. It is started from the Add Credit Note button on a validated invoice.

name: account_invoice_refund_link
summary: Shows the link between a credit note and the invoice it refunds, through an Invoice reference field on the credit note. Each refund line also keeps track of the original invoice line it reverses. This makes it easy to see what was refunded from which invoice.

name: account_invoice_refund_link_sale
summary: Links a credit note created from a sales order to the original invoice, when the refund covers lines that were invoiced on that specific invoice. It applies to products set to delivered quantities invoicing. Refunds raised from the sales order then point back to the right invoice.

name: account_invoice_refund_reason
summary: Lets you define a list of reasons for credit notes, such as returned goods or a pricing error. When a credit note is created from an invoice or bill, the user picks a reason, and reasons can be reported on. The reasons are managed under Accounting > Configuration > Management > Refund Reasons.

name: account_invoice_section_sale_order
summary: When one invoice covers several sales orders, it adds a section line above each order's lines, named after that sales order. This makes it clear which invoice lines came from which order. The section naming scheme and grouping can be configured on the company and on the customer.

name: account_invoice_send_template
summary: Adds a mail template choice to the batch send wizard for customer invoices. Pick the email template before sending, or leave it on the default. It is used from the Send action after selecting one or more invoices.

name: account_invoice_show_currency_rate
summary: Makes posted foreign currency invoices show the exchange rate that matches the amounts actually booked, rather than only the system rate. This matters when an invoice was posted at a different rate or its amount was edited by hand. The rate shows on the invoice and on its journal items.

name: account_invoice_subscription_per_contact
summary: Lets you subscribe a user as a follower on a specific contact, so they are notified when invoices are created for that contact or its children. This goes beyond the single email address on a contact and keeps notifications targeted. Subscribe the user from the contact's chatter using the Invoice Created subtype.

name: account_invoice_supplier_ref_unique
summary: Stops the same vendor bill being entered twice by checking that the vendor and the bill reference together are unique, ignoring case. A duplicate bill is blocked when saved, which protects against paying the same bill twice. It is switched on with the Check Unicity on Supplier Invoice Number option in the Vendor Bills settings.

name: account_invoice_supplierinfo_update
summary: Adds a Check Supplier Info button on vendor bills that compares each line's price and quantity with the product's vendor pricelist. A wizard shows the proposed changes, such as a new vendor price line or an updated price, and the user can accept or drop them. Use it to keep vendor prices current after a supplier changes its rates.

name: account_invoice_tax_note
summary: Lets you write a note on each tax group that prints on customer invoices whenever a tax from that group is used. The note is translatable and can differ by company, and it complements the note set on a fiscal position. It is edited on the tax group, which is set from the tax's form under Accounting > Configuration > Taxes.

name: account_invoice_tax_required
summary: Stops an invoice from being confirmed while any line has no tax. When a user tries to confirm an invoice with an untaxed line, Odoo raises an error and blocks the confirmation. Use it when every invoice line must carry a tax.

name: account_invoice_transmit_method
summary: Sets a transmit method on each contact, such as Email, Post or Customer Portal, and copies it to new invoices, where it can be changed. Customers have a sending method and vendors have a reception method, both on the Sales & Purchase tab of the contact. The list of methods can be extended, and other modules add their own, such as Chorus Pro for French public-sector e-invoicing.

name: account_invoice_transmit_method_substitution_rule
summary: Lets you set rules that swap the transmit method on an invoice when it matches a condition, such as a missing email address, or a direct debit payment that must go by post. Rules are defined under Accounting > Configuration > Management > Transmit Method Substitution Rules and apply when the invoice is created. The rule's domain decides when a substitution happens.

name: account_invoice_tree_currency
summary: Optionally shows a currency column in the customer and vendor invoice list views. It helps when a list mixes invoices in several currencies. Nothing else in invoicing changes.

name: account_invoice_triple_discount
summary: Gives each invoice line three successive discount fields, applied in order so each one acts on the price left by the previous discount. This suits trade discounts that stack on top of each other. The resulting net price shows on the invoice line and in the totals.

name: account_invoice_warn_message
summary: Shows a warning popup on the invoice form when the customer has a warning message set on its contact, so the user notices before posting. The warning text is copied onto the invoice itself. Use it for customer-specific notices that staff must see.

name: account_mail_autosubscribe
summary: Automatically adds chosen contacts as followers on their company's invoices, so they receive copies of invoice emails. It is enabled per contact with the Invoices option in the In copy of field. It builds on the mail autosubscribe feature.

name: account_manual_currency
summary: Lets users set a currency manually on draft invoices and bills, and choose between the rate on the accounting date and a special rate agreed with the other party. Tick Manual Currency on the draft to type the rate, which also carries into the payment registration wizard. Users need access to multiple currencies to use it.

name: account_menu_invoice_refund
summary: Adds combined menus so that Customers shows Invoices and Credit Notes together, and Vendors shows Bills and Refunds together. It only changes where the documents are found in the menu. No data or workflow is added.

name: account_move_auto_post_ref
summary: When a recurring invoice is set to auto-post, the next draft invoice it generates keeps the customer reference from the previous one. This saves retyping the reference on every recurring invoice. The customer reference is set on the Other info tab of the invoice.

name: account_move_cancel_confirm
summary: When a user cancels an invoice or journal entry, a confirmation wizard appears with an optional reason field. This adds a safety step before cancelling posted accounting documents. The behavior is set up through the base cancel confirmation module.

name: account_move_pivot_view
summary: Adds a pivot view to customer invoices, vendor bills, refunds and receipts, so users can summarize amounts by any field in a table. Pivot is an extra view mode on those lists, alongside list and form views. It is useful for quick totals by customer, month or product.

name: account_move_tier_validation
summary: Adds tier validation to journal entries, invoices and bills, so they need approval from configured reviewers before they can be posted. A user requests validation, reviewers approve in the Reviews tab, and then the entry can be posted. The Needs my Review filter shows what is waiting on you, and tiers are set under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: account_move_tier_validation_approver
summary: Lets each supplier have a default approver for vendor bills, set on the supplier's Sales & Purchase tab. A bill then gets that person as Responsible for Approval, and a tier can be configured to use that field, so the right person signs off. The bill cannot be posted until the tier is validated.

name: account_payment_state_keep_draft
summary: Lets customer and vendor payments be registered in Draft instead of being posted and marked as Paid straight away. Draft payments can be checked before they are confirmed, and reconciliation happens once the payment is posted. The default state is set per payment type under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings.

name: account_portal_invoice_search
summary: Adds search by invoice name and reference to the Invoices & Bills page in the customer portal. Portal users can find a specific document faster. Nothing changes for internal users.

name: account_receipt_journal
summary: Lets you create journals used only for sales and purchase receipts, and makes receipts use them automatically. Once a receipt journal exists, normal journals can no longer be used for receipts. The option is set on the journal itself.

name: account_receipt_send
summary: Adds a Send button and a dedicated mail template for sales receipts, so a receipt can be emailed to the customer like an invoice. It is switched on with the Sale Receipt option under Invoicing > Configuration > Customer Invoices. Receipts are then created from the Customers > Receipts menu.

name: account_tax_group_widget_base_amount
summary: Adds the base amount to the tax group summary shown on invoices and receipts, including their printed reports. Customers and reviewers can then see the taxable base beside each tax total. Only the report display changes.

name: account_tax_legal_notes_translate
summary: Makes the Legal Notes field on taxes translatable, so the same legal text can be stored in each language used on documents. The field is a rich text field, so formatted notes can be entered. It is set on the tax's form.

name: account_tax_one_vat
summary: Ensures only one VAT tax can be used on each product and invoice line, a rule some countries such as Belgium require. Products get VAT and VAT name fields, and a warning or error appears when a second VAT is chosen. Turn it on with the One VAT tax only setting, and mark a tax as VAT under its advanced options.

name: account_tax_one_vat_purchase
summary: Applies the one VAT tax rule to purchase order lines, so only one VAT tax can be picked on a line. It extends the one VAT tax module for purchasing and needs no extra setup.

name: account_tax_one_vat_sale
summary: Applies the one VAT tax rule to sales order lines, so only one VAT tax can be picked on a line. It extends the one VAT tax module for sales and needs no extra setup.

name: account_warn_option
summary: Adds preset blocking or warning messages to customers. On a customer's Internal Notes tab, pick a Warn Option under Warning on the Invoice, and that message shows whenever an invoice is made for the customer. The Warnings option in the customer invoice settings must be turned on first.

name: partner_invoicing_mode
summary: Technical base module that adds an Invoicing Mode to customer contacts, with a standard default, and a way to generate invoices automatically on a schedule for standard customers. Sales orders are grouped by company, invoiced partner, currency and payment term, and a Next Invoice Date appears on the contact. Other modules build on it to offer at-shipping, weekly and monthly invoicing.

name: partner_invoicing_mode_at_shipping
summary: Lets a customer be set to invoicing At Shipping, so their invoice is created and validated automatically when goods are delivered. A One Invoice Per Shipping option also exists, but it does not work with this mode. The mode is set on the customer contact and the sales order.

name: partner_invoicing_mode_monthly
summary: Lets a customer be set to monthly invoicing, so their sales are invoiced automatically once a month. The invoicing day is set in the company settings. The mode is chosen on the customer contact.

name: portal_account_personal_data_only
summary: Restricts portal users so they see only the invoices that belong to their own contact or its children. Without it, portal users can see any invoice where a colleague in their organization is a follower. This keeps documents private between members and departments.

name: product_customerinfo_invoice
summary: Shows the customer's own product code on customer invoices, taken from the product's customer information. Each invoice line carries the code defined for that customer and product. It depends on the product customer info module.

name: product_form_account_move_line_link
summary: Adds a Journal Items button on product forms, for both the product template and its variants, so you can jump straight to the accounting lines for that product. The button shows how many of those lines exist, labeled as invoiced. It appears on the product form in the Sales, Purchase and Inventory apps.

name: purchase_stock_picking_return_invoicing
summary: Extends purchase orders so supplier returns and refunds are tracked per line. Each line shows billed and refunded quantities, and received and returnable refundable quantities, so vendor bills and refunds are created with the right amounts. Refund quantities are proposed automatically when the bill or refund is created.

name: sale_credit_note_reversal
summary: Allows a credit note to be reversed back into a customer invoice, and ensures the reversal counts as an invoice on the sales order. It also helps when a credit note was posted by mistake, such as a negative quantity line that should have been an invoice. The sales order's invoice count reflects the corrected document.

name: sale_invoiceability_on_payment_transaction
summary: Allows a sales order to be invoiced once a confirmed payment covering the full order amount exists, even when products are set to delivered quantities. The user can create the invoice from the sales order without validating a delivery first. No configuration is needed.

name: sale_invoicing_date_from_picking
summary: Makes sure the invoice date chosen in the sales invoice wizard is used when invoices are created from selected deliveries (pickings). It connects the invoice date wizard with the picking filter. Use it when you invoice sales orders with a chosen date and specific deliveries.

name: sale_invoicing_date_selection
summary: Lets users set the invoice date in the Create Invoices wizard on sales orders, so all invoices created in that run get the same date. It is useful when invoices should be dated differently from the day they are created.

name: sale_line_refund_to_invoice_qty
summary: Lets you choose whether a credit note's refunded quantity should count as quantity to reinvoice on the sales order line. A checkbox on the credit note can stop refunded quantities from being deducted from the invoiced quantity, and a company default can be set. This decides how much remains to invoice on the order.

name: sale_order_invoicing_grouping_criteria
summary: Lets you define extra criteria for grouping sales orders into one invoice, on top of the standard company, customer and currency rule. Criteria are set under Invoicing > Configuration > Management > Invoicing Grouping Criteria. Orders that differ on those fields are invoiced separately when Invoice Order runs.

name: sale_order_invoicing_qty_percentage
summary: Lets you invoice a percentage of the ordered quantity on a sales order, such as 50 percent of 10 hours giving a 5-hour invoice line. Choose Percentage of the quantity in the Create Invoice wizard and enter the percentage. It is useful for partial or progress billing.

name: sale_stock_picking_invoicing
summary: Lets you choose, per company, whether sales are invoiced from the sales order, from the delivery (stock picking), or from both. Invoices created from deliveries use the sales order's pricing and partner details, and invoicing from the order marks the delivery as invoiced. The Sale Invoicing Policy is set in Settings or on the company.

name: sale_timesheet_invoice_description
summary: Adds timesheet details to the invoice lines created from timesheet-based sales orders, so the invoice shows what work was done. The description style is chosen under Timesheet Invoice Description in the Timesheets settings, in the Billing section. Lines can also be split by timesheet.

name: stock_account_move_reset_to_draft
summary: Lets a vendor bill be reset to draft even when a valuation difference was created against a receipt whose stock has not yet been consumed. On reset, Odoo creates an offsetting stock valuation entry that reverses the price difference. It is useful for products using average cost or FIFO costing.

name: stock_picking_invoicing
summary: Lets you create invoices straight from a delivery or receipt (stock picking), without going through a sales or purchase order. A button on the picking asks to create the invoice, and selected pickings can be grouped into one invoice from the list view. An Invoicing tab then shows the invoices created from it.

name: stock_picking_return_refund_option
summary: Lets you change the refund option on delivery moves after they are confirmed, so returned products can be refunded even after an invoice exists. It works for sales and purchase orders, by updating the To Refund option on the delivery. Use it when a customer or supplier returns goods after invoicing.

name: account_banking_mandate
summary: Adds banking mandates, the signed authorization a customer gives a company to collect direct debits from their bank account. Mandates are stored on bank accounts and linked to customer invoices, debit orders and payments, and can be managed from Accounting or from the bank account itself. Debit orders are found under Invoicing > Customers > Debit Orders.

name: account_banking_mandate_contact
summary: Lets you choose a specific banking mandate, and therefore a specific bank account, on a contact. When a debit order is made for that contact's invoices, the chosen mandate is used. It is set on the Sales & Purchase tab of a contact, typically a child contact.

name: account_banking_mandate_sale
summary: Adds a Direct Debit Mandate field on sales orders. When a payment mode that requires a mandate is picked, the customer's first valid mandate is selected by default. The mandate is then copied from the sales order to the invoice.

name: account_banking_mandate_sale_contact
summary: Combines the sales mandate and contact mandate features, so the mandate chosen on a customer's contact is used on sales orders and copied to invoices. A company setting decides whether the default mandate comes from the sale partner, the invoice address or the delivery address. A customer's contact mandate is set on its Sales & Purchase tab.

name: account_banking_pain_base
summary: Technical base module with the shared fields and logic for SEPA payment files in the PAIN format. It adds initiating party identifiers and PAIN settings to payment modes, payment methods, payment orders and the company. It has no screens of its own, and the SEPA credit transfer and direct debit modules build on it.

name: account_banking_sepa_credit_transfer
summary: Exports payment orders to SEPA credit transfer XML files (PAIN 001), used to send supplier payments to the bank in one file. Create a payment mode for SEPA credit transfer, choose the PAIN version, and create a payment order under Invoicing > Vendors > Payment Orders. The XML file is then generated for upload to the bank.

name: account_banking_sepa_direct_debit
summary: Exports direct debit payment orders to SEPA direct debit XML files (PAIN 008), used to collect customer payments in bulk from their bank accounts. Set your SEPA creditor identifier in the invoicing settings, then create a debit order under Invoicing > Customers > Debit Orders. The XML file is generated for upload to the bank.

name: account_invoice_select_for_payment
summary: Adds a selection button before the Number column in the invoice list, used to mark invoices as Selected for payment. Use the Selected for payment filter, select the lines, and then choose Register payment from the Actions menu. The selection clears once a payment is registered.

name: account_payment_method_base_mode
summary: Glue module that makes the payment mode screens inherit from the standard payment method views. It adds no new features, but keeps the payment method screens consistent across the two modules. It is technical, and nothing needs configuring.

name: account_payment_mode
summary: Adds Payment Modes, a way to classify incoming and outgoing payments and route them to banks. Each mode links a payment method, a bank journal or allowed journals, and a payment type, and is managed under Invoicing > Configuration > Management > Payment Modes. On its own it adds no screens for users; other modules rely on it.

name: account_payment_order
summary: Adds payment orders for vendor payments and debit orders for customer collections, where you pick the open invoice lines to pay or debit and then generate the bank file. Payment orders are under Invoicing > Vendors > Payment Orders, and debit orders under Invoicing > Customers > Debit Orders. Supplier and customer invoices also get Add to Payment Order and Add to Debit Order actions.

name: account_payment_order_grouped_output
summary: Adds an option to create extra grouped journal entries for a payment order, so a large batch can be reconciled on the bank statement as one or a few entries by payment date. The option is set on the payment mode. It is useful when a big payment run is hard to match line by line.

name: account_payment_order_notification
summary: Adds a button on payment and debit orders that emails each related customer or vendor a summary of their transactions in that order. Recipients can be reviewed in a wizard before sending. The order keeps a count of the notifications it has generated.

name: account_payment_order_return
summary: Adds an option in the Create Payment Lines wizard to include invoices linked to a payment return, so a rejected direct debit can be collected again in a new debit order. Tick Include move lines from returns before adding all lines. It extends the payment order and payment return features.

name: account_payment_order_tier_validation
summary: Adds tier validation to payment orders, so they need approval from configured reviewers before payments are confirmed. Request validation on the order, review the pending approvals in the Reviews tab, then confirm the payments once everyone has approved. Tiers are configured under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: account_payment_partner
summary: Adds customer and supplier payment modes to contacts, and a payment mode on invoices that defaults from the contact. When creating a payment order, invoices are filtered by payment mode, and invoices without a mode still appear. It also controls how much of a customer's bank account number is printed on the invoice.

name: account_payment_purchase
summary: Adds a Supplier Bank Account and a Payment Mode to purchase orders, copied from the vendor and then carried onto the vendor bill. They can be changed on a draft order or bill if needed. The bill then carries the right bank details for payment.

name: account_payment_purchase_stock
summary: Glue module that connects purchase payment modes with purchasing and receiving. It adds no new screens of its own. It is technical and used by other modules.

name: account_payment_sale
summary: Adds a Payment Mode field to sales orders, copied from the customer and then onto the customer invoice. It can be changed on the order or on a draft invoice. This routes sales payments through the right payment mode automatically.

name: account_vendor_bank_account_default
summary: Lets you set a default bank account on each supplier, used on their vendor bills as the recipient bank account. If none is set, Odoo uses the first bank account created on the contact. It is set on the Sales & Purchase tab and applies to company contacts or individuals with no parent company.

name: account_vendor_bank_account_default_purchase
summary: Carries the supplier's default bank account onto purchase orders, and from there onto the vendor bills created from them. The bank account shows on the purchase order's Other info tab. It is set on the supplier's contact.

name: account_bank_statement_cascade_delete
summary: When a bank statement is deleted, its statement lines are deleted with it, instead of being left behind as separate journal entries. This is useful for cleaning up a wrongly imported statement completely. It is done from the journal's Operations > Statements list using Action > Delete.

name: account_statement_import_base
summary: Technical base module that shares code between the file-based and online bank statement import modules. It adds a unique import ID and raw data to bank statement lines, which helps avoid importing the same line twice. It has no screens of its own.

name: account_statement_import_camt
summary: Adds import of CAMT.053 and CAMT.054 bank statement files, the SEPA XML formats that banks use for statements and payment batches. Once installed, these formats are available in the statement import wizard on a bank journal. It is a file format add-on for the generic statement file import.

name: account_statement_import_camt54
summary: Imports CAMT.054 customer payment batch files into a dedicated journal, reconciling the customer invoices as paid and posting the payments to an internal transfer account. You then import the full CAMT.053 statement into the bank journal to clear that transfer account. It can also add a balancing line to the statement and includes Swiss QRR partner reference support.

name: account_statement_import_file
summary: Provides the framework for importing bank statement files from a bank journal's dashboard. Choose a file, and Odoo creates one or more bank statements and attaches the original file for reference. Format-specific modules, such as OFX or spreadsheet imports, add support for the actual file types.

name: account_statement_import_file_reconcile_oca
summary: Adds an Import and Start to Reconcile button to the statement import wizard, so after importing a file the user goes straight to the reconciliation screen. It joins the file import and the reconcile modules together. It requires both to be installed.

name: account_statement_import_move_line
summary: Adds an Import journal items button on a bank statement and on the bank journal's dashboard. It opens a wizard that filters and selects accounting lines to add as bank statement lines. Users need the Show Full Accounting Features group to use it.

name: account_statement_import_ofx
summary: Adds support for importing OFX bank statement files, a common format that banks export, including files that cover several bank accounts. Use it from the statement import wizard on a bank journal. Only the transactions needed for accounting are brought in.

name: account_statement_import_ofx_by_acctid
summary: Adds an OFX ACCTID field to bank accounts, so OFX statements are matched to the bank account by that value. If the field is empty, Odoo falls back to the account number. Use it when the ID in your OFX files differs from the number saved in Odoo, and set it under Contacts > Configuration > Bank Accounts.

name: account_statement_import_online
summary: Technical base for online bank statement providers, which pull transactions from a bank's web service into Odoo. A provider is set up on a bank journal under Online Bank Statement Providers, and statements are then pulled for a chosen date range. Empty statements can be allowed per provider, and the Show Full Accounting Features group is required.

name: account_statement_import_online_gocardless
summary: Pulls bank transactions from GoCardless Bank Account Data into bank statements for a bank journal, either on request or through a scheduled pull. It needs a GoCardless account and a user secret configured on the provider. GoCardless provides a free API for connecting bank accounts.

name: account_statement_import_online_paypal
summary: Pulls PayPal transactions into bank statements for the journal that represents the PayPal account, for a date range you choose. It needs a Client ID and Secret from a PayPal for Business account. The statements then appear in the usual reconciliation flow.

name: account_statement_import_online_plaid
summary: Pulls bank transactions from Plaid.com into bank statements, with both Sandbox and Production environments supported. Set Bank Feeds to Online on the bank account, choose Plaid as the online provider, and sync from the bank account's actions. Statements can then be pulled for a date range.

name: account_statement_import_online_ponto
summary: Pulls transactions from MyPonto.com into bank statements for linked bank accounts, for a date range you choose or through the scheduled pull. Set Bank Feeds to Online on the bank account and select MyPonto as the online provider. Once configured, new transactions arrive without manual imports.

name: account_statement_import_online_stripe
summary: Pulls Stripe balance transactions into a bank journal as statement lines, with Stripe fees recorded separately. The provider is set up on the bank journal, with options for the label, note and reference of each line. It helps match Stripe payouts to bank entries.

name: account_statement_import_online_wise
summary: Pulls Wise.com transactions into bank statements for a linked account, either for a date range or through the scheduled pull. Strong Customer Authentication uses keys generated or pasted in the provider settings. Set Bank Feeds to Online on the bank account and select Wise as the provider.

name: account_statement_import_sheet_file
summary: Imports TXT, CSV or XLSX files as bank statements, mapping the file's columns to Odoo fields using a saved sheet mapping. You create one mapping per bank export format under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Statement Sheet Mappings. Use it when your bank gives you a spreadsheet export.

name: account_statement_import_sheet_html_file
summary: Detects when an XLSX bank file is actually an HTML file, which some banks export, and reads it as a bank statement. It extends the spreadsheet statement import and needs no extra setup. It is a technical parser add-on.

name: account_statement_line_order
summary: Adds a Statement Line Internal Index setting on bank journals, which controls how bank statement lines are ordered. A second option keeps lines from the same statement together, which fixes the mixed order when several statements arrive on the same day. It is set on the journal.

name: agreement_rebate_partner_company_group
summary: Applies rebate agreements to all members of a company group, not just the single contact. When rebate settlements are created from invoices of several group members, the agreement covers all of them. It relies on the partner company group setup.

name: contract
summary: Manages recurring contracts for customers and suppliers, which generate invoices automatically on a schedule. Customer contracts are under Invoicing > Customers > Customer Contracts and supplier contracts under Invoicing > Vendors > Supplier Contracts, each with a journal, recurrence settings and contract lines. Portal users who follow a contract can see it, and the contract report can be printed or emailed.

name: contract_analytic_tag
summary: Lets you add analytic tags to contract lines, so the invoice lines generated from them carry those tags. This restores analytic tagging for recurring billing. It is set on each contract line.

name: contract_forecast
summary: Generates future forecast periods for each contract line, showing the expected invoice dates and amounts for the coming months or years. Forecasts open from the contract's Forecast button, in pivot or list view, and regenerate automatically when quantity, price or dates change. The number of periods and the monthly or yearly type are set in General Settings.

name: contract_forecast_variable_quantity
summary: Regenerates contract forecasts automatically when a contract line's quantity type or quantity formula changes. It joins the forecast and variable quantity features, so forecast figures stay in step with variable quantities. It is an integration add-on with no new screens.

name: contract_invoice_auto_validate
summary: Validates contract invoices automatically right after they are created, instead of leaving them as drafts. It is turned on with the Auto validate contract invoices company setting. The CONTRACT_INVOICE queue channel must have a capacity of 1 in the Odoo configuration to avoid sequence conflicts.

name: contract_invoice_manually
summary: Adds a Manually Invoiced option on contracts, which excludes them from automatic invoicing. They are then invoiced by hand from the Manually Invoice Sale Contracts or Manually Invoice Purchase Contracts menus, using a chosen date and filter. Manual invoicing must be enabled in the settings first.

name: contract_invoice_start_end_dates
summary: Adds start and end dates to the invoice lines generated from a contract, when the product is marked as Must have dates. The dates come from the contract line, so the invoice shows the service period. It is useful for subscriptions and other recurring services.

name: contract_layout_category_hide_detail
summary: Brings the section hide-detail options to contracts, so each section can hide its line details, its subtotal or its line amounts. These choices carry into the contract report, the customer portal and the invoices generated from the contract. Section settings from a sales order are passed on to the contract.

name: contract_line_successor
summary: Manages the life of each contract line, including stopping, suspending, cancelling, renewing and planning a successor line. Lines carry states such as In-Progress, To Renew and Closed, and auto-renewal can either extend a line or create a new one. Turn on Recurrence at line level in the contract, then use the line actions.

name: contract_mandate
summary: Lets you choose a direct debit mandate on a contract, so the invoices it generates use that mandate. Select the partner, the mandate and the recurrence, and each new invoice carries the mandate. It is set on the contract form.

name: contract_payment_mode
summary: Lets you choose a payment mode on a contract, so its invoices use that payment mode. The contract starts with the customer's payment mode and it can be changed. It is set on the contract form under Invoicing > Customers > Customer Contracts.

name: contract_price_revision
summary: Lets you raise or set contract line prices in bulk from a wizard, either by a percentage or to a fixed price, from a chosen start date. Select the contracts, run Create revision of contract lines from the Action menu, and set the date range and the change. Previous prices are kept on each line for reference.

name: contract_queue_job
summary: Makes the contract invoicing cron job create one background job per contract, rather than creating all invoices in a single transaction. This means one failure does not hold up every other invoice. It is enabled with the contract.queue.job system parameter.

name: contract_refund_on_stop
summary: Lets you stop a contract line after it has been invoiced. If the stop date is earlier than the last invoiced date, a refund invoice is created for the unused period and the line ends on the stop date. It needs the prorated variable quantity module, and it is enabled under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings in the Contracts section.

name: contract_sale
summary: Gives sales users access to contracts without accounting rights. Users in the sales Only Own Documents group see only the contracts they created, and can open them under Sales > Sales > Contracts. This lets sales staff manage recurring contracts without billing access.

name: contract_sale_generation
summary: Lets a contract generate sales orders instead of invoices. Set the contract Type to Sales, and optionally have the sales orders it creates confirmed automatically. This is useful when recurring work needs an order before it is invoiced.

name: contract_sale_invoicing
summary: Adds pending sales orders that share an analytic account to the recurring invoice a contract generates, so they are billed together. Tick Invoice Pending Sales Orders on the contract. Each invoicing run checks for unbilled orders on that analytic account.

name: contract_sale_mandate
summary: Carries the direct debit mandate from a sales order to the contract it creates, and from there to the contract's invoices. It joins the sales mandate, contract mandate and product contract features together. It adds no new screens of its own.

name: contract_sale_payment_mode
summary: Carries the payment mode from a sales order to the contract it creates. A company setting allows a separate payment mode for contracts created from sales orders, which is set on the order. The contract's invoices then use that payment mode.

name: contract_sale_transmit_method
summary: Carries the transmit method (email, post or portal) from a sales order to the contract it creates, so the contract's invoices are sent the same way. It joins the sales transmit method, contract transmit method and product contract features. It adds no new screens of its own.
